t: This is the statue of William Edward Forster, a Grade II listed monument in the Temple Gardens section of the Victoria Embankment Gardens. It was made by the sculptor Henry Richard Hope-Pinker, who was known for portraits and statues of Victorian figures. Forster was a Liberal statesman who, in Gladstone's government, steered through the Elementary Education Act of 1870, the foundation of compulsory national free education for children. His reputation was later tarnished by his policies as Chief Secretary for Ireland, which earned him the nickname Buckshot Forster from Irish nationalists.
